name: gasrescue
description: Send or swap USDC, USDT and USDG from a wallet without gas, on Base, Arbitrum, Ethereum, HyperEVM, Robinhood Chain, Solana and Tron.
long_description: The wallet signs, gasrescue.io submits the transaction and pays the network fee, and its fees come out of the amount. Check any wallet for stuck or issuer-frozen stablecoins, quote a send or a swap into the gas coin, and submit the signatures. Optionally the server signs EVM quotes with its own wallet, after checking every signed field against the quote.
